thread:
luke: Heads-up: corp card declined at the SFO rental kiosk this morning. Had to put the insurance on my personal card (USD 49.99). Kiosk printed a tiny receipt. Can I get reimbursed and how do I mark this in Ramp?

hana: Ugh. Did the terminal give any decline reason? Sometimes chip error or velocity limit. We should capture the rental folio + the tiny receipt + the Ramp transaction for the decline if present.

luke: Terminal just said "declined". ramp activity shows an attempted preauth with last4 5544 and a pending decline. I saved a photo of the screen and the handwritten paper receipt from the kiosk. Rental agreement shows base rental covered by company, only insurance paid personally.

expense-bot: Reminder: For personal-card emergency reimbursements attach: 1) merchant receipt, 2) screenshot of the terminal/decline if available, 3) explanation in the expense note. Use expense title "SFO rental insurance - 2026-10-14". Manager approval required for >$50.

matt: @luke add a brief note with why corp card declined (terminal msg + time). We'll need manager jill to approve since policy flags card declines. Also include last4 for corp card.

luke: added note + uploaded photo of terminal, receipt, and Ramp activity. corp last4 5544.

jill: thanks for the quick upload. I approve the reimbursement for USD 49.99. please select cost center ENG-PLAT and mark "emergency personal card" so finance-ops can route.

finance-ops: Received expense and manager approval. Processing reimbursement. Quick note on bookkeeping: we will code expense to travel->vehicle misc and flag the corp card incident for card-ops to review limits. Expect ACH reimbursement in 3-5 business days.

luke: awesome, thanks all. any follow-up I should do for card-ops?

hana: if you have time, forward the terminal decline screenshot to card-ops at card-ops@redwood.com so they can check card limits and whether an unblock is needed for future airport kiosks. not urgent but helpful.

luke: done, forwarded. thanks again.
